about_the_game:
The galaxy bleeds. You play as an ancient Artificial Mind, awakened to bring peace to its many worlds. But peace, of course, is a relative term.

Your purpose is simple: build. Build giant city-factories that cover entire planets. Build armies that fight on your behalf. Build a future.

Once the flow of troops and resources is secure, your goal is to conquer the rest of the map. War is inevitable. But are you prepared?

Your power starts with what you build. Your city-factories are breathing machines. Their streets clogged with conveyor belts and choked in smoke. On every planet, you will construct industrial labyrinths, transforming wastelands into hubs of your expanse.

Design production chains to supply your massive army. Make everything from plasma swords to rocket launchers, from towering mech hulls to advanced tech. But industry alone is not enough.

Balance building, defending, and expanding to ensure that your cities can withstand the pressure of total galactic war. Such is the price of peace.

YYou are the architect of war. Every building, system, and unit under your command is assembled to your specifications. Adapt your designs to countless threats. Link up component-producing buildings — changing hulls, weapons, and battle systems on the fly. 

Soon enough, the metal carcasses of your city will resonate with the battle cries of your machines. You will lead this vast army of your creation to dominate the battlefield.


The galaxy is vast. Across its many worlds, each one an opportunity. And a challenge.

Explore uncharted worlds and build a thriving industrial empire. Expand your reach to the outer rim of the galaxy by upgrading your Mothership. Play through the handcrafted single-player campaign and try to beat the roguelite mode. Your command shapes the future of the galaxy. Will you rebuild it in your image?

name: Warfactory

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel 2.3 Ghz to 2.69 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Master the industry of endless war across countless worlds. Build sprawling city-factories, design machines of war, and command massive armies in battle. Bring order to the galaxy on the brink of collapse in Warfactory.
supported_languages:
English*, Ukrainian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Thai, Turkish, Hungarian, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
